verification.scope: Shared source InputManager native singleton/Update/OnGUI, mouse/touch/multi/key event boundaries and default PlayerInput subscription
verification.notClaimed: OS/device input injection, original CLog policy, full actual Main/account/platform/UI composition or complete outgame Player build

findings: Native OutgameInputManager MonoBehaviour singleton follows Find named InputManager -> GetComponent -> AddComponent -> DontDestroyOnLoad, using Unity destroyed-null semantics. Update calls CheckTouch; OnGUI calls key handler. Android/iPhone/WebGL choose touch through original short-circuit platform reads; other platforms use mouse.

Mouse source reads independent XY/press positions; Down > Up > Held. Movement uses exact coordinate inequality. Mouse Click precedes End; touch End/Canceled precedes Click, strict distance<MoveStep50, live callback state and exceptions preserved. No invented UI blocking, debounce, cancel suppression or WebGL mouse fallback.

Multi-touch rebuilds active list each frame, original array indices, excludes ended/canceled, dispatches Hold when none moved (including all Began), Move when any moved. Scale is current-first-two distance minus previous-first-two distance divided by50, after callback, with live mutable list. Active<2 returns; zero count dispatches MultiEnd only if retained count>=1. No synthesized MultiBegin.

Keys initialize list even for absent event; only GUI key events update. Repeated KeyDown avoids duplicate Down but still Hold; KeyUp invokes before removal using live HeldKey. Hold receives live list; zero KeyCode preserves current key. Shutdown clears14 delegates and preserves history/owner; registration supports duplicates and one-at-a-time removal. Begin registration logs before combination, preserving failure ordering.

OutgamePlayerInput default constructor now registers directly with actual InputManager; explicit adapters retained for probes. Native run verifies Unity Update -> default input -> Player.OnTouchBegin -> source native ray gate; disposal unsubscribes, other listeners remain, Shutdown clears old subscriptions while frames continue, persistent-scene placement and destroyed-owner recreation verified.

811 integrated checks (19 new) and10 native pass. Native device reads are explicitly scripted, not OS input or original matched replay. Original CLog policy remains a supplied host boundary (default Unity debug sink). InputManager is framework type3603, so controller roster remains10/38 method-level implementations,28 remaining.
